oracleRisk.summary: USDh is issuer-minted from deposited USDC or USDT and backed by a centrally operated BTC basis strategy; Hermetica may pause redemptions when valuation feeds fail but does not expose a borrower-liquidation oracle path.

branchApplicability.rationale: Hermetica issues USDh directly to approved participants against USDC or USDT deposits and manages a protocol-level BTC/perpetual hedge. Users do not open collateralized debt positions, so there are no market-specific collateral-health or liquidation branches to inventory.
